page_title: MAR 2-1 LEN | Marseille v Lens 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
90+6' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul after Wesley Said (Lens) hacks down one of his opponents. Marseille earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+5' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
90+4' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+4' The resulting corner, taken by David Pereira da Costa (Lens), comes to nothing. The referee signals a corner kick to Lens.

90+4' Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Andy Diouf (Lens) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.

90+2' The most active player in today's match is definitely Pape Gueye (Marseille). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
90+1' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The game is interrupted now, Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
87' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.

85' 2 - 1 Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang produces a sweet pass and picks out Pape Gueye (Marseille) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 2:1!
84' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
84' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pape Gueye (Marseille) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Marseille are going to take it.
82' What an amazing save by Brice Samba! Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.
81' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
81' That will be all from Nampalys Mendy who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ruben Aguilar (Lens).
79' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luis Henrique (Marseille) replacing Jonathan Clauss.
77' 1 - 1 Goal! Massadio Haidara gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Wesley Said (Lens) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
77' A clever lofted pass finds Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) in space inside the box. He looks up and hits a precise shot towards goal, but Brice Samba is equal to it and makes an easy save.
76' Deiver Machado goes off the pitch and Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) comes on.
76' It's time for a substitution. Andy Diouf (Lens) comes on in place of Elye Wahi.
74' Referee Eric Wattellier sees the trip by Facundo Medina (Lens) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
72' Jean-Louis Gasset is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Michael Murillo suffers an injury and Jean Onana (Marseille) comes on.
70' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

70' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Lens manage to earn a corner.
69' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, makes a stunning save.
68' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle after David Pereira da Costa (Lens) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
65' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to substitute Iliman Ndiaye and he is replaced by Ismaila Sarr (Marseille).
65' A substitution has been made. Amine Harit is replaced by Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille).
65' The referee shows the yellow card to Elye Wahi (Lens).

64' Kevin Danso (Lens) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save to deny the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
63' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) has tested the patience of referee Eric Wattellier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
62' Here is a change. Angelo Fulgini is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to David Pereira da Costa (Lens).
62' Neil El Aynaoui is substituted due to injury. Franck Haise gives a chance to Wesley Said (Lens).
62' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) picks up an injury.
60' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
59' A dangerous looking corner kick from Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is cleared to safety by the defence.

58' CHANCE! Florian Sotoca (Lens) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Pau Lopez produces an excellent save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lens.
55' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kevin Danso (Lens) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

51' Deiver Machado (Lens) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. Lens will have a chance to score from a corner.
51' A pass from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is intercepted by Pau Lopez and the move breaks down.
50' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
49' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) serves up a nice cross, but Brice Samba punches the ball away.
48' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' The resulting corner from Angelo Fulgini (Lens) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45+2' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Lens have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+2' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) jumps into a tackle and Eric Wattellier signals a foul.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Brice Samba leaps to intercept the corner kick from Jordan Veretout (Marseille).
44' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.

42' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
41' Pape Gueye (Marseille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
40' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
38' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is quickest to pounce on the rebound and from point-blank slams a header against the right post. What a chance!
38' Kevin Danso (Lens) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
38' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' Florian Sotoca (Lens) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Lens force their opponents to concede a corner.
36' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) trips an opposition player and Eric Wattellier signals a foul.
34' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Neil El Aynaoui (Lens). Eric Wattellier saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
32' Deiver Machado (Lens) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Pau Lopez easily makes the save.
32' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared.

31' It will be a corner kick for Lens. A sweet pass finds Angelo Fulgini (Lens) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Pau Lopez is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
31' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Pau Lopez and he's equal to it.
31' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
30' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens). The referee blows his whistle, Lens are awarded a corner kick.
28' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
27' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Florian Sotoca (Lens). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
24' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for an infringement.
22' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Florian Sotoca (Lens) heads on.
20' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
17' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jonathan Clauss (Marseille), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
15' The resulting corner from Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is cleared by the defence.
14' Brice Samba displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
12' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
11' Brilliant play from Elye Wahi (Lens) to get past Pau Lopez in goal, but he fails to find the net from an acute angle.
10' Pape Gueye (Marseille) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
10' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is about to take a corner kick.
10' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Marseille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
7' Marseille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
6' A cross from the by-line finds Angelo Fulgini (Lens) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.

3' Elye Wahi (Lens) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.

1' 1 - 0 What a wonderful finish! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Marseille will kick the game off.
Eric Wattellier is introduced as the referee for today's match.
